scripts.neuracle-bridge: bash -c 'ROOT="${OI_MI_ROOT:-$HOME/Documents/oi-mi}"; PY="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"; if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then PY=python3; fi; OI_MI_ROOT="$ROOT" "$PY" bridges/neuracle/ws_bridge.py'
scripts.model-service: bash -c 'NCC="${NCC_OI_BCI_ROOT:-$HOME/Documents/NCC-OI-BCI}"; PY="$NCC/.venv/bin/python"; if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then PY=python3; fi; PROFILE="${MODEL_DEVICE_PROFILE:-neuracle59}"; cd "$NCC" && if [ -n "$MODEL_PACKAGE" ]; then "$PY" scripts/serve_runtime_model.py --package "$MODEL_PACKAGE" --host 127.0.0.1 --port "${MODEL_SERVICE_PORT:-8768}" --strategy "${MODEL_STRATEGY:-none}" ${MODEL_STATE_FILE:+--state-file "$MODEL_STATE_FILE"}; else echo "[model-service] MODEL_PACKAGE 未设置，启动 dev mock ($PROFILE)…"; "$PY" scripts/serve_dev_mock_model.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port "${MODEL_SERVICE_PORT:-8768}" --profile "$PROFILE"; fi'
scripts.tetris-rl:train:smoke: bash -c 'cd tetris-rl && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m tetris_rl train --algo dqn --smoke'
